correctness.rationale: Conditional common means and cross-edge zero covariance imply all off-diagonal imaginary cyclic correlations I_d(s) satisfy a closed tridiagonal recursion with coefficient μ_s(1−μ_s); variance-only diagonal C0 is real and disappears. The same recurrence governs deterministic mean split vertices, so shoelace area expectations agree for every t. Discrete Fourier diagonalization gives the stated product, regular-polygon geometric decay and n² diffusive exponential limit. Shared Bernoulli counterexample shows covariance hypothesis essential. Independently enumerated a joint-dependent but pairwise-independent two-stage rational test: expectation and deterministic mean area both 3/16.
